header: L14 · The maintainer on duty · sonnet
verdict: R10-05 holds: 05 'Safe to paste' now links to 04 4.1 and states the narrower claim. One new Required: the 12.1 command block still shows the runnable line go run ./tools/ci pr, which the delta turned into a different package (./tools/ci/pr).

findings.section: 12 12.1 (command block, PR checks lines) vs 12 12.4 and 10 10.2
findings.defect: The delta builds pr as its own main package tools/ci/pr and says the run step is go run ./tools/ci/pr, but the contributor command block in 12.1 still lists 'go run ./tools/ci pr <payload file>' and 'go run ./tools/ci pr --title <t> --body <file>' as commands to type. 12.4 only says the shorthand 'tools/ci pr' means the package, which does not cover a literal command line in a code block; 10.2 already uses go run ./tools/ci/pr.
findings.scenario: A first-time contributor copies the PR-checks line from 12.1 to check the PR body before opening the pull request; the dispatcher in tools/ci has no pr subcommand, so the command fails and the contributor cannot run the check that the pr job will run, or the implementer builds the subcommand the block shows and breaks the import-closure test.
findings.change: Change both lines of the 12.1 block to go run ./tools/ci/pr (and the 'All checks' comment stays); have the tools/ci workflows or a docs test fail when a command block names go run ./tools/ci pr.

out_of_scope: ADR 0010 count, the askpass wording of 05 and 06, and the gh floor were skimmed for contributor impact only; no L14 defect found.
confidence: Medium: read by grep and the delta text, not run.
